caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with an attached mirror, shown in three views: front elevation, side elevation, and top view. The dresser is illustrated in shades of brown, indicating a wood finish, and has three large drawers, each fitted with two round knobs. Above the drawers, the dresser top extends outward slightly with a defined edge. The attached mirror is centrally positioned and is flanked by two tall, rectangular, wooden cabinets, each featuring decorative scrollwork at the upper corners and a small round knob. The mirror itself is arched at the top with a decorative carved crest in the center and shows subtle light blue shading, suggesting reflection. The side elevation and top view are drawn in plain line, without color, showing the shape and structure of the piece; the side elevation reveals ogee bracket feet and the relative thickness of the dresser components. The drawing includes handwritten labels for each view, a scale (1 ½ inch to 1 foot), and a signature in the lower right corner.
title: Bride's Bureau
